blank_lines_upper_bound.description: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines allowed.

collapse_markup_spaces.description: When `true`, consecutive whitespace in markup is collapsed into a single space.

line_ending.description: Policy for generated line breaks. Literal source text is preserved.

reorder_import_items.description: When `true`, import items are sorted alphabetically.

tab_spaces.description: Number of spaces to use for each indentation level.
